mapper.select: /* com.portal.system.menu.MenuManageMapper.selectMainMenuHead */ SELECT b.MENU_NO AS menuNo, b.MENU_ORDR AS menuOrdr, b.MENU_NM AS menuNm, b.UPPER_MENU_NO AS upperMenuId, b.MENU_DC AS menuDc, b.RELATE_IMAGE_PATH AS relateImagePath, b.RELATE_IMAGE_NM AS relateImageNm, b.PROGRM_FILE_NM AS progrmFileNm, ( SELECT c.URL FROM LETTNPROGRMLIST c WHERE b.PROGRM_FILE_NM = c.PROGRM_FILE_NM ) AS chkURL FROM LETTNMENUCREATDTLS a INNER JOIN LETTNMENUINFO b ON a.MENU_NO = b.MENU_NO WHERE b.MENU_NO > 0 AND b.UPPER_MENU_NO = 0 AND a.AUTHOR_CODE = ( SELECT c.AUTHOR_CODE FROM LETTNEMPLYRSCRTYESTBS c WHERE c.SCRTY_DTRMN_TRGET_ID = #{tmp_UniqId} ) ORDER BY b.MENU_ORDR ASC

/* com.portal.system.menu.MenuManageMapper.selectMainMenuLeft */ SELECT b.MENU_NO AS menuNo, b.MENU_ORDR AS menuOrdr, b.MENU_NM AS menuNm, b.UPPER_MENU_NO AS upperMenuId, b.RELATE_IMAGE_PATH AS relateImagePath, b.RELATE_IMAGE_NM AS relateImageNm, ( SELECT c.URL FROM LETTNPROGRMLIST c WHERE b.PROGRM_FILE_NM = c.PROGRM_FILE_NM ) AS chkURL FROM LETTNMENUCREATDTLS a INNER JOIN LETTNMENUINFO b ON a.MENU_NO = b.MENU_NO WHERE a.AUTHOR_CODE = ( SELECT author_code FROM LETTNEMPLYRSCRTYESTBS WHERE SCRTY_DTRMN_TRGET_ID = #{tmp_UniqId} ) ORDER BY b.MENU_ORDR ASC

/* com.portal.system.menu.MenuManageMapper.selectMainMenuHeadByAuthor */ SELECT b.MENU_NO AS menuNo, b.MENU_ORDR AS menuOrdr, b.MENU_NM AS menuNm, b.UPPER_MENU_NO AS upperMenuId, b.MENU_DC AS menuDc, b.RELATE_IMAGE_PATH AS relateImagePath, b.RELATE_IMAGE_NM AS relateImageNm, b.PROGRM_FILE_NM AS progrmFileNm, ( SELECT c.URL FROM LETTNPROGRMLIST c WHERE b.PROGRM_FILE_NM = c.PROGRM_FILE_NM ) AS chkURL FROM LETTNMENUCREATDTLS a INNER JOIN LETTNMENUINFO b ON a.MENU_NO = b.MENU_NO WHERE b.MENU_NO > 0 AND b.UPPER_MENU_NO = 0 AND a.AUTHOR_CODE = #{authorCode} ORDER BY b.MENU_ORDR ASC

/* com.portal.system.menu.MenuManageMapper.selectMainMenuLeftByAuthor */ SELECT b.MENU_NO AS menuNo, b.MENU_ORDR AS menuOrdr, b.MENU_NM AS menuNm, b.UPPER_MENU_NO AS upperMenuId, b.RELATE_IMAGE_PATH AS relateImagePath, b.RELATE_IMAGE_NM AS relateImageNm, ( SELECT c.URL FROM LETTNPROGRMLIST c WHERE b.PROGRM_FILE_NM = c.PROGRM_FILE_NM ) AS chkURL FROM LETTNMENUCREATDTLS a INNER JOIN LETTNMENUINFO b ON a.MENU_NO = b.MENU_NO WHERE a.AUTHOR_CODE = #{authorCode} ORDER BY b.MENU_ORDR ASC
